title: Grow Little Bunny B3: game contract (generic game input, HUD elements, replay envelope, shared pack format crate)
body:
A game-neutral contract a community game uses: a generic game-input channel, a small HUD element set, a replay envelope, and the pack format moved out of the Everglade zone crate.

Spec: docs/verse/games/grow-little-bunny.md (Milestones, B3).
